reference_propositions.reference_proposition: Parse maintains distinct escape/quote states, starts pos=-1 and advances an explicit ordinal once per range iteration.
Whitespace is appended while quoted/substitution states apply. Otherwise accumulated tokens may undergo replacement and recursive parsing with both flags disabled.

Backtick and dollar substitution branches call shellRun only where their ParseBacktick guard is enabled; invalid parenthesis forms can return invalid command line string. Platform helper source is presently flattened/incomplete.
Single/double quote toggles depend on other quote states; closing a quoted token marks argQuoted, allowing empty quoted arguments.

Unquoted control/redirection symbols terminate this parse at Position rather than executing a complete shell pipeline; the digit/redirection adjustment is a selected source condition, not general shell support.
Final token processing repeats expansion handling; unfinished escape/quote states return nil/error before p.Position assignment. Position is assigned only on successful completion.
ParseWithEnvs calls Parse and propagates errors, then extracts only the leading isEnv tokens until the first non-env; it does not install assignments into the process environment.
isEnv checks strings.Split(arg, equals) length2, not POSIX variable-name validity. Package wrappers construct a new Parser for each call.
isSpace recognizes four specific whitespace runes; do not claim all Unicode whitespace or full POSIX compliance.
